title: Design System: tmuxifier — The Bench Instrument

display.purpose: The empty-stage standby prompt only — 42px/400, the terminal's own vocabulary, not a headline.

nameplate.purpose: The login h1 — 26px/700, lowercase (brand commitment), 0.22em tracking, standby lamp beside it.

title.purpose: Modal and hub headings; uppercase, tracked 0.1em.

legend.purpose: Key labels, engraved section labels, tabs, chips; 700, uppercase, 0.12–0.16em tracking.

body.purpose: Rows, prose, hints; regular case Meslo at 12.5px.

field.purpose: Text inputs and selects — typing in the glass at 14px.

glyph.purpose: Icon keys and closes at 14–16px; geometry, not copy.

readout.purpose: Meta figures, timestamps, event times at 11px; tabular-nums. JuliaMono serves as the unicode-range symbol fallback (U+2000–2BFF) behind Meslo.

shadows.name: key-edge
shadows.purpose: Keycap extrusion at rest: hard machined edge plus soft contact shadow.

shadows.name: key-edge-mini
shadows.purpose: Small inline keys (row action pads, hub row buttons).

shadows.name: recess
shadows.purpose: Recessed screen glass: inputs, logs, the stage grid.

shadows.name: panel-mount
shadows.purpose: Mounted panels (sidebar) sitting on the bench.

shadows.name: logo-mount
shadows.purpose: The login logo badge's physical mount.

shadows.name: lamp-off
shadows.purpose: Unlit LED: ring + dark fill so a dark lamp still reads as a lamp.

shadows.name: engrave
shadows.purpose: Text-shadow for engraved nameplates (cut into metal, not lit).

shadows.name: amber-focus
shadows.purpose: Input power-on focus glow, layered over recess.

shadows.name: amber-engaged
shadows.purpose: Engaged mode key glow (Fleet Command armed); pulse peaks at 0 0 18px rgba(255,176,0,0.28).

motion.name: ease-mechanical
motion.purpose: Panel/drawer transforms, 0.22–0.25s: mechanical directness, no bounce.

motion.name: standby-blink
motion.purpose: The standby cursor; reduced motion holds it solid.

motion.name: standby-breathe
motion.purpose: The login nameplate's standby lamp; reduced motion holds it lit.

motion.name: armed-pulse
motion.purpose: Fleet Command engaged; reduced motion holds the steady glow.

components.name: Commit Key
components.description: The one safety-orange committing action per view (Unlock, Run on N boxes, Create).
components.css: .ds-key-commit { padding: 11px 16px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #c94f0e; border-bottom-color: #8f3708; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ff7d38, #f56413); color: #1a0e05; font-family: 'MesloLGMDZ Nerd Font', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #7a2f06, 0 4px 10px rgba(255,106,26,0.2), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.28); cursor: pointer; } .ds-key-commit:hover { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ff8a4d, #fb6c1a); } .ds-key-commit:active { transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #7a2f06, inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.2); } .ds-key-commit:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,176,0,0.6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Function Key
components.description: Neutral extruded keycap for secondary actions; legend brightens on hover, travels on press.
components.css: .ds-key-fn { padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #282c33; border-bottom-color: #101216; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1e2127, #191c21); color: #b9b4a6; font-family: 'MesloLGMDZ Nerd Font', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.13em; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.55), 0 3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.3), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-key-fn:hover { color: #e6e2da; } .ds-key-fn:active { transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.55), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.03); } .ds-key-fn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,176,0,0.6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Recessed Input
components.description: Typing happens in the glass: recessed screen-well field that powers on amber when focused.
components.css: .ds-input { padding: 9px 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #282c33; border-top-color: #1f2228; background: #0a0b0d; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); color: #e6e2da; font-family: 'MesloLGMDZ Nerd Font', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12.5px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8a8577; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgba(255,176,0,0.45); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,176,0,0.12); }

components.name: Box Row
components.description: A fleet-cluster key: status lamp, name legend, readout meta line; attached rows carry the amber Lamp-and-Beacon.
components.html: builder01cpu 12% · mem 41% · disk 63%
components.css: .ds-box { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'MesloLGMDZ Nerd Font', ui-monospace, monospace; background: #16181d; } .ds-box:hover { background: #1c1f25; border-color: #282c33; } .ds-box.ds-active { background: #1c1f25; border-color: #282c33; box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 #ffb000, inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.04); } .ds-box-main { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; } .ds-box-name { color: #e6e2da; font-size: 12.5px; } .ds-box-meta { color: #8a8577; font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-lamp { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; flex: 0 0 auto; } .ds-lamp-ok { background: #3ecf6e; box-shadow: inset 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.25), 0 0 6px rgba(62,207,110,0.5); }

components.name: Mode Chip
components.description: Machined state tag, lit or dark: amber = alive (working), orange = operator action (waiting).
components.html: AGENT WORKING AGENT WAITING DETACHED
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid #282c33; background: #1c1f25; color: #b9b4a6; font-family: 'MesloLGMDZ Nerd Font', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; line-height: 1.7; } .ds-chip-working { color: #ffb000; border-color: rgba(255,176,0,0.35); background: rgba(255,176,0,0.07); } .ds-chip-waiting { color: #ff6a1a; border-color: rgba(255,106,26,0.5); background: rgba(255,106,26,0.1); }

components.name: Status Lamp Set
components.description: The LED vocabulary: off, ok, warn, crit, needs-auth. An off lamp still reads as a lamp.
components.css: .ds-lamp2 { display: inline-block; width: 9px; height: 9px; margin-right: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #23262c; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.07), inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); } .ds-on-ok { background: #3ecf6e; box-shadow: inset 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.25), 0 0 6px rgba(62,207,110,0.5); } .ds-on-warn { background: #ffb000; box-shadow: inset 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.25), 0 0 6px rgba(255,176,0,0.5); } .ds-on-crit { background: #ff5c47; box-shadow: inset 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.25), 0 0 6px rgba(255,92,71,0.55); } .ds-on-auth { background: #a98bff; box-shadow: inset 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.25), 0 0 6px rgba(169,139,255,0.55); }

components.name: Tab Legend
components.description: Engraved tab legends over a seam; the active tab lights amber.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid #282c33; } .ds-tab { padding: 7px 12px; background: none; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: #8a8577; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'MesloLGMDZ Nerd Font', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #b9b4a6; } .ds-tab-active { color: #ffb000; border-bottom-color: #ffb000; text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255,176,0,0.3); }

narrative.overview: Tmuxifier is a desk instrument for operating a fleet: a machined charcoal chassis holding a control cluster on the left and a screen bay on the right. Every control is a physical part — box rows are keys with status lamps, buttons have key travel, section labels are engraved legends, and live values glow amber like an OLED readout. The terminal is the device's display: the brightest, most alive thing on the bench, recessed into the chassis rather than floating above it. The personality is tactile, deliberate, warm-lit: matte surfaces, small honest shadows, one saturated action color, and glow that only ever means "powered and live." Anti-references bound the world on both sides: not 2010 skeuomorphism (no gloss gradients, no leather, no oversized bevels), and not the neon terminal dashboard the category always ships (the previous cyan-phosphor world is retired evidence, not a precedent).
keyCharacteristics: One legend face: the bundled Meslo mono is the entire product's voice — engraved chassis legends, key labels, readouts, and the terminal itself share it
Chassis neutrals (charcoal, gunmetal, bone, putty) with two functional accents: amber = live, safety orange = operator action needed
Depth by machining: keys extrude 1–2px and travel down when pressed; screens recess with an inset lip; nothing floats except true overlays
Status is hardware vocabulary: LED lamps (green/red/amber/violet) and lit-vs-dark chips
Density serves supervision: dense keycap rows for the fleet, one glowing display at a time

rules.name: The Orange Means You Rule
rules.body: Safety orange appears only where the operator's press is the point: primary commits and states waiting on the operator. Never decoration, never headers, never more than one solid-orange key per view.

rules.name: The Amber Means Alive Rule
rules.body: Amber glow marks something currently powered/working — readouts, live values, engaged modes, focus. A resting surface never glows.

rules.name: The LED Rule
rules.body: Green/red/violet appear only as machine-state semantics (lamps, chips, status text). Never decorate with them.

rules.name: The One Legend Face Rule
rules.body: MesloLGMDZ Nerd Font (bundled, with MesloLGSDZ and JuliaMono fallbacks) is the only face in the product. No sans-serif anywhere.

rules.name: The Glow Is Power Rule
rules.body: Amber emission appears only on live/engaged elements. Glow never signals altitude; shadow never decorates.

rules.name: The Lamp-and-Beacon Rule
rules.body: Selection/attachment is a lamp turned on plus a 2px amber inset bar on the part's left edge; the row lifts one chassis step. Keyboard focus is the shared amber ring.

dos: Do pull every color from the frontmatter tokens; the :root custom properties in style.css are the same system in code.
Do give every part its material: extrude interactive parts, recess content glass, keep the chassis visible between mounted panels.
Do keep one solid-orange commit per view and let everything else stay neutral.
Do give every animation a prefers-reduced-motion alternative that holds a meaningful resting state (cursor solid, glow steady, key un-pressed).
Do write legends uppercase, bold, tracked (0.12–0.16em) at 10–11px.
donts: Don't reintroduce the retired cyan/blue-glass world or any foreign accent hue; the GitHub blues are gone, not resting.
Don't gloss: no glass highlights taller than 1px, no gradients steeper than 6% L across a surface, no drop shadows on resting inline parts.
Don't let amber and orange trade jobs: amber never commits, orange never merely glows.
Don't use LED colors decoratively or repurpose violet away from needs-auth.
Don't put a sans-serif anywhere; if a glyph is missing, it comes from the bundled fallback monos, not a system sans.
